description: One-off packs of credits with a price: tiles in two or four columns, or rows.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Packs of credits as tiles: the amount, a badge, the price and a buy button. Axes: columns (2, 4), item (tile,
  row), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Pack } from "./credit-packs.types";

export type CreditPacksProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  packs: Pack[];
  empty?: string;
  badges: Record<string, string>;
  buy: string;
  cols?: "2" | "4";
  item?: "tile" | "row";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Badge from "../compose/Badge.vue";
import Box from "../compose/Box.vue";
import Button from "../compose/Button.vue";
import Card from "../compose/Card.vue";
import CardContent from "../compose/CardContent.vue";
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import { at, cn, fitCols, fmtMoney } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  packs,
  empty = "",
  badges,
  buy,
  cols = "4",
  item = "tile",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<CreditPacksProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :measure="(((item as string) === 'row') ? '2xl' : 'default')"
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <EmptyState v-if="((packs?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="coins" :title="empty" />
    <Grid v-else
      :cols="
        (item as string) === 'row' ? '1'
        : fitCols((((cols as string) === '2') ? '1-2' : '1-4'), (packs?.length ?? 0))
      "
      class="gap-4"
      data-testid="items"
    >
      <Card v-for="pack in packs" :key="pack.id"
        variant="default"
        :class="cn(
          'h-full',
          (
            (item as string) === 'row' ? 'gap-4 p-4'
            : (density as string) === 'compact' ? 'gap-4 p-4'
            : ''
          )
        )"
        data-testid="item"
        :data-badge="pack.badge"
      >
        <CardContent
          :class="cn(
            'flex h-full gap-4',
            (((item as string) === 'row') ? 'flex-row flex-wrap items-center justify-between' : 'flex-col')
          )"
        >
          <Stack gap="2" align="start" :class="cn('min-w-0', (((item as string) === 'row') ? 'flex-1' : ''))">
            <Box
              v-if="(pack.badge || (((item as string) !== 'row') && (packs.filter((i) => i['badge']).length > 0)))"
              class="flex min-h-6 items-center"
              data-slot="badge-slot"
            >
              <Badge v-if="pack.badge" variant="default" size="default" class="w-fit shrink-0" data-testid="badge">
                {{ at(badges, pack.badge) }}
              </Badge>
            </Box>
            <Stack gap="0" class="min-w-0">
              <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
                {{ pack.name }}
              </Title>
              <Text size="2xl" weight="bold">
                {{ fmtMoney(pack.price, pack.currency) }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
          <Button
            :variant="((pack.badge === 'popular') ? 'default' : 'outline')"
            size="sm"
            type="button"
            :class="cn('w-fit shrink-0', (((item as string) === 'row') ? '' : 'mt-auto'))"
            data-testid="buy"
          >
            {{ buy }}
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Grid>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
